newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile shrs end firm, Chispas rally on power deal.
newsitem.headline: Chile shrs end firm, Chispas rally on power deal.

text.p: Chilean blue chips rallied to close over one percent higher with the market led by the Chispa stocks, which surged on news of the deal between Spanish utility Endesa and Enersis.
The news is seen continuing to buoy the bolsa next week as more details emerge of the $1.5 billion deal, the largest ever in Chile's energy industry, they said.
"There may well be more positive news from Endesa, which will keep stocks rallying," said Enrique Danioni, head of research at brokerage Sud American.
The .IPSA index ended up 1.19 percent at 135.69 points.
The general .IGPA index gained 0.51 percent to 5,735.79 points amid turnover of 12.5 billion pesos.
Traders reported heavy speculation in the Chispa group of investment companies on news Endesa will buy the firm's A and B series stock to take a controlling stake in Enersis.

"The deal is positive but we need to study it more to see various aspects including the administration and whether there will be changes in the company's policy towards investing abroad," said one analyst.

Investors are betting that Endesa will buy the stocks for up to 250 pesos per share with many disbelieving Endesa's statement that the offer will only apply to shareholders owning stock on May 30, said traders.
Almendros rose 17.82 percent to 205 pesos, while Chispauno rose 14.53 percent to 205 pesos.
Losers included telecom Telex, down 7.69 percent at 900 pesos and copper products maker Madeco , which shed two percent at 980 pesos.
